g.text: From a URL or user story to a verified Playwright spec. Planner, Explorer, Critic, Healer, Transcriber
the verified session as a spec.
user story or Jira ticket text.
Takes one DOM snapshot of the target URL → emits a numbered scenario list.
Categories: happy · negative · edge · a11y. Each scenario gets a one-line rationale.
Export the scenario list to plan.csv. Stakeholders open in Excel / Sheets, set Approve=no to skip rows.
Resume the run with npm run explore -- --from-plan plan.csv.
Agentic tool-use loop driving Playwright live. Every action verified against the real page
before the next is taken. Selectors resolved via cascade and recorded with their level.
→ output: verified trace · cascade stats · scenario lifecycle
Reads the verified trace, scores each scenario as ship · weak · fix, with one-line reasons.
Catches loose assertions, redundancy, missing negative cases, fragile selectors.
Verified trace → Playwright spec in TypeScript or JavaScript. No LLM call. pure code generation.
Emits selectors at their cascade-resolved level. Auto-injects @axe-core/playwright a11y check.
an Approve column for review mode.
When a spec fails on a selector miss, runs the spec, finds failures, opens the URL in a fresh browser,
proposes replacements, verifies each resolves to exactly one element, then emits a patched spec.
→ output: <spec>.healed.{ts,js} with inline audit annotations + confidence scores
on every PR. Manual-trigger eval job.
QA-Core v0.3 · Multi-agent Playwright generation on Claude
